summary.text: April Berg is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 44-Position 2, where she has served since January 2021, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She is a former Boeing procurement agent and program manager and the former owner of a bed and breakfast in Edmonds.

paragraphs.text: April Berg, according to her House Democrats biography, was raised on the south side of Chicago and moved to the Northwest for her education.

She says she was elected the first Black and youngest student body president in the history of Oregon State University and was later appointed by Oregon's governor as a student representative to the state's Board of Higher Education.
Berg worked in aerospace as a Boeing procurement agent and program manager and owned The Edmonds Inn: Bed and Breakfast.
She served on the Edmonds School Board and the Everett School Board and as a planning commissioner for the City of Mill Creek.
She took office in the House on January 11, 2021, and her biography describes her as the first Black woman to represent the 44th District.
She says she has lived in Snohomish County for more than 20 years.
